principle: Game research defines legality and known relationships. Community evidence ranks sensible choices where no Nordeus best-value table is exposed.

notes: Formation score includes current XI quality, natural-role fit, role floor, Playstyle fit and structural matchup.
Tactics score includes XI fit, opponent/shape context, exact recovered condition drain and shipped semantic tie signals.
Mentor score is capped by the three families actually unlocked at the user's saved Mentor level.

high_confidence_rules: DMC receives extra value against AMC and central overloads.
DL/DR coverage receives extra value against opponent wide attackers.
AMC receives extra value when the opponent has no DMC.
Two-sided width receives extra value against narrow opposition.
Three-centre-back vs back-four remains conditional, not universal.

squad_coverage_blueprint.status: flexibility guide, not a mandatory roster size
squad_coverage_blueprint.rule: Best available XI today and recruitment/development gaps are reported separately.

rules: No opponent DMC + usable AMC favours central focus.
Narrow opponent + two-sided width favours both flanks.
Target Man favours direct/aerial distribution and higher crossing.
False Nine/Enganche/Regista can favour short combination buildup.
High press + counter-press and low block + regroup are coherent pairs.
Low block + offside trap receives a contradiction penalty.

mentors.rule: A locked family contributes exactly zero, even if that Mentor would be ideal when fully levelled.

training.hierarchy: role -> Playstyle -> tactic context -> current deficiency -> drill efficiency
training.grey_skill_rule: Grey skills retain zero utility. Playstyle priorities are intersected with the player's actual white-skill union.
training.deficiency_rule: Existing mean(top-3 white skills) target is retained, then multiplied by the transparent hierarchy priority before drill beam search.
training.coverage_rule: Intense multi-white drills accumulate useful weighted need; exact server-side gain is still not predicted.
